about-greeting: AroTaro is an application that provides swift and accurate tarot consultations based on AI technology.
about-content:
The roots of tarot are shrouded in the mists of time, but its mysterious and magical tradition is believed to have originated in 15th-century Italy. Initially emerging as a card game, it soon evolved into a tool used to explore the human soul, connecting with the unconscious and facilitating communication with the inner voice.

AroTaro has reimagined the ancient mysteries with modern sensibilities using AI technology, making it easily accessible and convenient anywhere, anytime. With charming images of tarot cards and insights tailored to each individual's life based on extensive AI analysis, Arotaro offers a delicate understanding. Whether you are anywhere, with AroTaro, you can have your own special moments, engaging in sincere conversations with your inner voice.

Beyond being a tool for glimpsing into the future, AroTaro listens to your story and provides comfort to your heart. AroTaro is not just a companion in difficult moments but also supports and assists you in making the right decisions.
